keySentence: The emperor loved beautiful clothes very much.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Two men came. They said they could weave magic cloth. The emperor was excited. The emperor loved beautiful clothes very much.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Two swindlers came to the kingdom with a clever trick. They said they could weave cloth invisible to fools. The emperor loved beautiful clothes very much and got excited. He gave them gold and silk to make the special fabric. The swindlers pretended to weave but made nothing at all. Everyone was too afraid to say they could not see anything.
facts.Word cards: emperor = 임금님 / new = 새로운 / clothes = 옷 / wardrobe = 옷장
